desc: Implement core DP: cost table (bytearray 26n), backward pass computing B[i] and R3[i][c] with array('q') and INF sentinels; early return "" when n < 3.
Implement lexicographic reconstruction walk with states B / R1 / R2 / R3, including the proven tie rule (continue unless B[i]'s best char d < cur).
Verify against examples, edge cases, and brute-force cross-check on random short strings (n ≤ 8) for cost optimality and lexicographic minimality, especially the R3 continue/end tie logic.
Final performance sanity check at n = 5·10⁴ (random and adversarial all-'z'/alternating inputs) and confirm memory usage is acceptable.
